summary: Comprehensive testing of Multi-Meal Slots feature for German Meal Planner. All backend APIs work correctly (11/11 tests passed). Frontend UI components (SlotCell, SlotDetailDialog, SlotConfigDialog) are fully functional. Multi-meal slots allow multiple dishes per meal slot with individual portions, side dishes, and optional member assignment.
passed_tests: GET /api/mealplans returns meal slots as arrays (not single objects)
POST /api/mealplans saves single meal per slot correctly
POST /api/mealplans saves multiple meals in same slot correctly
Meal with side_dishes saves and retrieves correctly in multi-meal slot
Shopping list aggregates ingredients from all meals in multi-meal slots
assigned_to field persists correctly for group member assignment
Clear all meals from slot works (empty array)
Update individual meal portions in multi-meal slot works
Remove individual meal from multi-meal slot works
Backward compatibility: old single-object format normalized to arrays in GET response
GET /api/groups/my endpoint returns group members for assignment
SlotCell shows total portions sum across all meals in slot
SlotCell shows Nx indicator when N>1 meals in slot (e.g., '2x')
Detail overlay opens on filled slot click
Detail overlay shows all meals with portions and side dishes
Detail overlay has 'Gericht hinzufügen' button to add another meal
Detail overlay has 'Alle' button to clear all meals
Detail overlay has X button to remove individual meal
Detail overlay has 'Bearbeiten' button to edit individual meal
Portions +/- controls work for each meal in detail overlay
Side dish portions +/- controls work in detail overlay
Recipe picker opens from detail overlay 'Gericht hinzufügen' button
Recipe picker opens for empty slot click
SlotConfigDialog shows portions input and side dishes section
Save (Speichern) persists multi-meal data correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies warning in MealPlanner.jsx (lines 54, 577) - consider adding eslint-disable comment or fixing dependencies
seed_data_creation: Test data created in week 2026-04-06 and cleaned up after tests. Existing data in week 2026-03-23 includes Spaghetti Carbonara with Grüner Salat side dishes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-meal slots feature is fully implemented and tested. Backend model changed from Optional[MealSlot] to List[MealSlot]. Each meal slot (breakfast/lunch/dinner) can now hold multiple meals. SlotCell shows total portions sum and Nx indicator. Detail overlay (SlotDetailDialog) allows viewing/editing/adding/removing individual meals. SlotConfigDialog handles recipe selection and configuration. Shopping list correctly aggregates ingredients from all meals. Group members fetched from /api/groups/my for optional assigned_to field.

backend_model.DayPlan: date, breakfast: List[MealSlot], lunch: List[MealSlot], dinner: List[MealSlot]

frontend_components.SlotCell: Shows total portions sum, Nx indicator for multi-meal, grip icon for drag/drop
frontend_components.SlotDetailDialog: Overlay showing all meals with portions, side dishes, +/- controls, edit/remove buttons
frontend_components.SlotConfigDialog: Recipe picker and configuration dialog for adding/editing meals

key_functions.getMealsForSlot: Returns array of meals for a slot (handles legacy single-object format)
key_functions.getTotalPortions: Sums portions across all meals in slot
key_functions.handleConfirmSlot: Adds or updates meal in slot array
key_functions.updateMealPortions: Updates portions for specific meal by index
key_functions.updateMealSidePortions: Updates side dish portions for specific meal
key_functions.removeMealSideDish: Removes side dish from specific meal

multi_meal_feature_details.backward_compatibility: GET /api/mealplans normalizes old single-object format to arrays, adds missing side_dishes and assigned_to fields
